chunks: And by this isnad, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih al-Asadi, from Muhammad ibn Harun, from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), who said:
If one of you prays without mentioning the Prophet (may God bless him and his family), his prayer is taken along a path other than the way to Paradise.

key_terms.سَبِيلِ الْجَنَّةِ: the way to Paradise — the spiritual path that leads to salvation; used here to indicate that the prayer's efficacy is nullified by the omission
key_terms.يُسْلَكُ: is taken along a path — passive form suggesting the prayer itself is redirected or misdirected

ai.seo_question: What happens if you pray without sending blessings on the Prophet according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) warns that a prayer performed without invoking blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) is spiritually misdirected — it does not lead toward Paradise. This teaching emphasizes that salawat (invoking blessings on the Prophet) is an essential component of prayer, not a mere formality. The warning reflects the Shia tradition's deep emphasis on the inseparability of love and honor for the Prophet from valid worship.
